purpose: Formal protocol for the CYNIC contribution pool. Inspired by Bitcoin's Stratum protocol and Proof-of-Work, but the work is useful (build, audit, observation, relay).

definitions.node: Physical or virtual machine executing one or more agents. Network identity (IP, WireGuard key, DNS).
definitions.agent: Autonomous software process running on a node. Has role, capabilities, session. Executes loops.
definitions.loop: Deterministic algorithm: observe -> decide -> action -> prove. Core unit of agent behavior.
definitions.contribution: Verifiable proof of useful work produced by an agent's loop. Submitted to the pool for validation.
definitions.contributor: Agent identity registered in the pool. Identified by agent_id + role, not by node.
definitions.pool: Coordinator that distributes tasks, validates contributions, maintains the reward ledger.
definitions.epoch: Fixed-duration window (e.g. 2016 contributions) after which difficulty adjusts.
definitions.share: Partial contribution validated by the pool but not yet aggregated into a block.
definitions.block: Aggregation of validated shares with a merkle root. Anchors the epoch's contribution history.

build_proof.description: make:check / make:build / make:build-release succeeded on authorized node

audit_proof.description: Architecture boundary or ownership audit passed

relay_proof.description: Tag relayed from forgejo to github with verified read-back

handshake.description: Contributor registers with the pool. Declares role + capabilities.

difficulty.description: Pool assigns current difficulty target to contributor.

task.description: Pool dispatches a task to the contributor.

submit.description: Contributor submits completed work with proof.

ack.description: Pool validates and acknowledges (accepted/rejected + share value).

difficulty_adjustment.mechanism: Every epoch (2016 shares), recalculate difficulty based on actual vs target epoch duration.

merkle.description: Cross-registry integrity: every registry update produces a leaf. Pool aggregates leaves into a block-level merkle root.

governance.rule: Pool protocol rules can only be modified via a cynic governance proposal with human_admin approval.
governance.enforcement: Pool contract violations result in share rejection and optional contributor ban.
